notes.title: New Version (1.1.6) Fixes Level 34 Bug
notes.notes:
Previously, some players had noted that they couldn't finish Level 34, so we took a look and figured out the problem (it occurred on both Win and Mac). A fixed version of the game is now online. :)

If you have trouble forcing Steam to update the game (as we did), right click on Let There Be Life in your Library listing of games and choose "Properties." Open the "Local Files" tab and click on the "Verify Integrity of Game Cache" button. Steam should then make the necessary updates.

If you still have any problems, please let us know!

Starting on April 20th, we're having a week long sale to celebrate the warmer weather and return of plant life*. Let There Be Life will be discounted during this period, so if you've been curious to give it a try, now is the perfect time. :)
